_about: THE BORDER PACKS (docs/atlas-v2-border-packs.md): states the card windows draw from a small lazy file of their own, atlas/data/borders/<pack>.bin, instead of history.bin. One row per state: its label, the Cliopatria v0.2.0 name(s) of its rows, the YEARS the cards need (each drawn by the one row alive in it), the cards that name it (members.groups[].ids: ["pol:<key>"]) and why. A key must not be a series of polity-spec.json or war-series.json. Add a state with `node .claude/atlas-build/add-border.js <key> --cliopatria "<Name>" --years A,B --card <id>`; rebuild one pack with `build-history.js --pack <name> --extract --install`; CI runs check-border-packs.js.

goguryeo.label: Goguryeo
goguryeo.why: ko-106: the kingdom at its greatest extent; Cliopatria's rows of 480–489 and 523–554 are its largest (408,926 km²), and 480 is the first year of them.

russian_empire.label: Russian Empire
russian_empire.why: ru-276: Peter the Great near the end of his reign (1724); ru-341: Catherine the Great's empire in the year of her death (1796).

silla.label: Silla
silla.why: ko-161: Silla at its peak. Cliopatria's Silla rows end at 681 (86,616 km² from 567); its "Unified Silla" rows from 682 are the same kingdom after the unification and its largest (149,880 km² in 682–891), and 682 is the first year of them.
